(all c: Claim | (some Runner and unguarded[c]) implies c in Finding) and (all g: Tag | (no u: Unit | g->u in Name.tag) implies g in Finding) and (all t: Test | adrift[t] implies t in Finding) and (all p: Pointer | (no x: Target | p->x in Name.pointer) implies p in Finding) and (all u: Unit | (not used[u] and u not in Conflict) implies u in Finding) and (all r: Trailer, u: Unit | r->u in Follow.rel implies u in Finding) and (all d: Document | ((some u: Unit | d->u in Hold.units) and (no i: Index | d->i in Hold.indexes)) implies d in Finding) and (all d: Document | (some i: Index | d->i in Hold.indexes and i->d not in Match.rel) implies d in Finding) and (all c: Claim | (some s: Site | c->s in Name.site and (no o: Source | o->s in Hold.symbols)) implies c in Finding) and (all u, v: Unit | (u != v and u->v in Repeat.rel) implies u in Finding)
doubt: 'repeats another' read as repeating a different unit (u != v).

alloy: some Runner implies (all c: Claim | unguarded[c] implies c in Untesting)
all g: Tag | (no u: Unit | g->u in Name.tag) implies g in Rotting

doubt: 'reported as misindexed' read as checker reporting a misindexing; 'holds units' read as holding at least one unit.

alloy: all d: Document | (some i: Index | d->i in Hold.indexes and i->d not in Match.rel) implies d in Misindexing

all d1, d2, d3: Document | (d1->d2 in Extend.rel implies d1->d2 in Context.rel) and ((d1->d2 in Extend.rel and d2->d3 in Context.rel) implies d1->d3 in Context.rel)
all t: Test, c: Claim | (t not in Declared and checks[t, c]) implies c not in Untesting
doubt: 'undeclared test' read as a test the project does not declare.

alloy: all t: Test, b: Bug, s: Spec | (checks[t, b] and b->s in Sit.rel) implies s not in Untesting
all u: Unit | no Runner implies u not in Untesting
all f: Frontmatter | (f in Misquoted or f in Foreign or f in Unclosed or f in Unterminated or f in Doubled or f in Dangling or f in Looping or f in Stray) implies f in Refused
doubt: 'checker refuses it' read as Refused (a frontmatter the checker cannot read).

all d1, d2: Document | d1->d2 in Bare.rel implies ((all u: Unit | d1->u in Hold.units iff d2->u in Hold.units) and (d1 in Finding iff d2 in Finding))
all d1, d2: Document | d1->d2 in Bare.rel implies (all u: Unit | d1->u in Hold.units iff d2->u in Hold.units)
all d1, d2: Document | d1->d2 in Bare.rel implies ((d2 in Finding implies d1 in Finding) and (d1 in Finding implies d2 in Finding))
all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Unsayable and u in Generated and u in Differs) implies u in Stale
all u: Unit | (u in Generated and u not in Unsayable and u not in Differs) implies u in Current
doubt: 'its unit's formula' presupposes the unit holds a formula; not added as a condition (u in Logical) since the words do not state it.

alloy: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u in Stated and u not in Generated and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Handwritten
all u: Unit | u in Unsayable implies u not in Rewritten

all u: Unit | u in Current implies u not in Reported
all r: Run | (r->CheckCommand in Ask.rel and some w: Word | w in Flagged) implies r not in Exits0
all w: Word | (w not in Undeclared and w not in Misplaced and w not in Apart and w not in Unused) implies w not in Flagged
all w: Word | (w in Undeclared or w in Misplaced or w in Apart or w in Unused) implies w in Flagged
all s: Scenario | s in Impossible implies s in Raised
all s: Scenario | s in Possible implies s not in Raised

all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Term and u in Unchallenged) implies (some w: Signature | u->w in Expose.rel)
all u: Unit, w: Signature | (u not in Term and u in Logical and loneOn[u, w]) implies u->w in Expose.rel
all u: Unit, w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel implies u in Unchallenged
some u: Unit | u in Faulted
some s: Scenario | s in Impossible and s in Raised and (some u: Unit | s->u in Blame.rel and u->s in Frees.rel)
some u: Unit, w: Signature | u in Logical and u->w in Rely.rel and u->w not in Expose.rel
all q: Quantifier | (q in VariableSubject and fits[q]) implies q in AsSubjectPhrase
doubt: 'fits a noun phrase' attached grammatically to the variable; read as fits[q] since fits is only defined on the quantifier.

all q: Quantifier | q in VariableTwice implies q in InFull

all l: Series | l in RelativeBeforeLast implies l in AsBullets
all l: Series | l in NotClause implies l in AsBullets
some q: Quantifier | q in VariableWithCondition and q in NothingToAttach
doubt: 'has nothing else to attach' read as NothingToAttach.

some d: Definition | d in OneKind and d in NotAboutSubject
some d: Definition | d in OrInsideKind and d in NoKindFirst
always (all o: Owner | (enter[o] and o in Disposed) implies some Throwing')
doubt: 'an owner that pulse has disposed' evaluated at the moment of the entering.

alloy: always (all p: Owner | dispose[p] implies ((all c: Owner | (p in c.parent and c not in Disposed) implies ((no x: Cleanup | x in Registered and p in x.on and x not in Ran and runNow[x]) until dispose[c])) and (all a, b: Owner | (p in a.parent and p in b.parent and a not in Disposed and b not in Disposed and a->b in Birth.order) implies ((not dispose[a]) until dispose[b]))))
doubt: 'it is the parent of' refers to the disposed owner p; 'has not disposed' is evaluated at the moment p is disposed; the cleanup conditions (registered on p, not run) are evaluated at each moment before c is disposed.
